subject: Sr Sec Eng offer — band exception request for Sam Lee
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sr Sec Eng offer — band exception request for Sam Lee

Hi Mina / Rishi —

Quick context: Sam Lee (ex-identity infra lead at Umbra Systems) has finished interviews for the Senior Security Engineer role (Req #ACME-9372) and is excited about Redwood. Recruiter flags: Sam has a strong counteroffer timeline — they need a decision by Friday 3/12. Team wants to extend. Compensation market data attached.

Why request an exception:
- Compensation expectation: $220k base + 25% target bonus + equity ask slightly above our current band for Sr Sec Eng.
- Sam’s profile: 9 years infra/sec, led multi-region key management rollout, direct experience with customer audit requests (SOC2) — will materially reduce ramp time for the GRC integration work ACME needs.
- Hiring manager (Laura) believes this is mission-critical for the ACME PoC timeline and would like a firm offer to close.

What I need from you:
1) Approval to go up to $220k base (our Sr band top is $200k) as a one-off exception for this candidate.
2) Confirmation we can use an equity grant at Level L5+ stretch (details in comp-band-comparison.xlsx).
3) If approved, can TalentOps prepare an expedited offer and DocuSign packet?

Attachments: candidate_resume_sam_lee.pdf, comp-band-comparison.xlsx, offer_matrix_q1.pdf

Short timeline would help — recruiter is pushing. Happy to hop on a quick call this afternoon if helpful.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Recruiting Partner (Sales & Security)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: candidate_resume_sam_lee.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: comp-band-comparison.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sr Sec Eng offer — band exception request for Sam Lee

Diego — thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few quick items before I can greenlight: 

1) Business justification note (short): please add 2–3 bullets that explain how Sam’s skills shorten time-to-value for the ACME PoC and any revenue/retention impact. This helps for audit trail.
2) Hiring budget owner confirmation — who signs for delta vs. band? Is this coming from GRC hiring pool or ACME professional services project budget?
3) Proposed total OTE cap we can approve without exec sign-off: $240k OTE (base + target bonus + expected equity value). Anything above that needs VP approval.

If you can confirm the budget owner and provide the short justification I’ll prepare the formal exception memo and route for a single-approver sign-off. If they need the $220k base specifically and that pushes OTE > $240k, we’ll need Rishi or Laura to sign off.

Also flagged: I see comp-band-comparison.xlsx — nice work. Please add a single-line note in the doc showing comparable recent hires or offers we’ve closed in last 12 months.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of People Ops (Talent, Comp & Mobility)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: offer_matrix_q1.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sr Sec Eng offer — band exception request for Sam Lee

Hi team —

Thanks Diego — quick update from Sam’s side:
- Sam has a competing verbal offer from OmniCloud at $210k base + 20% bonus; they would like written confirmation by Friday 3/12 EOD PT.
- Sam is very interested in Redwood’s product/mission and prefers Redwood if we can match or come close to the cash comp and provide a clear career path.

If we expedite, Sam is willing to accept by Friday — if not, OmniCloud may press. Candidate is also asking about signing timeline for equity and whether there’s any accelerated vesting for initial 12 months (Sam is particularly interested in early ownership for retention).

I can get Sam to sign a short extension if you need 48 hours, but they prefer the written offer.

Sara

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sr Sec Eng offer — band exception request for Sam Lee

Thanks for the thread and the justification. I’ve reviewed the candidate materials and the budget ask. Approving an exception with the following conditions:

1) Base salary: approve up to $215,000 as a one-time exception (not to set a new band top).
2) OTE cap: total cash OTE (base + target bonus) must not exceed $245,000.
3) Equity: approve L5+ equity grant as proposed, subject to TalentOps standard grant paperwork.
4) Retention condition: include a 6-month cliff/commitment note in the offer language (no special accelerated vesting beyond standard policy).
5) Audit trail: Diego or Mina to archive the exception memo and attach to req in Greenhouse and to the candidate file.

Diego — please proceed to instruct TalentOps to prepare the offer packet and route DocuSign to Sam. Confirm if recruiter needs an extension or if we’ll send by EOD tomorrow.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance & People Operations (approvals)
Redwood Inference
